question: Which documents may the union publish to members through a member portal, which office may deposit or publish one, what file types, size limits, scanning and storage rules apply to a deposited file, which members or roles may read each document, and how long is it retained?
decision: Only authorized document publishers (officers/admins or a delegated communications/document officer) release materials; uploaded files must use the real scanned, typed, size-limited 25 MB intake with classification, versioning and audience grants enforced on every download. Retention is document-class/tenant-specific; no global deletion one year after unpublishing where contracts, labor obligations or legal holds require longer. Remove inaccessible/obsolete files from indexes and caches on withdrawal.
originalProposedDecision: Officers and admins publish portal documents; files go through /api/documents/upload (scan, size limit 25 MB, allowed types PDF, images and Office). allowed_roles and requires_auth are enforced on read. Default retention: until unpublished plus 1 year.
independentApprovalScope: decision wording / platform baseline only; NOT independent security or operational testing
